_comment: Copy to ~/.philont/mcp.json (or point PHILONT_MCP_CONFIG at this file). Each entry mounts an external MCP server whose tools automatically become agent-callable tools. 'browser' uses Microsoft's official Playwright (pure local stdio, free). capability=execute routes browser actions through onAuthRequest approval rather than auto-allowing them. You can also skip this file entirely and just set PHILONT_MCP_BROWSER=1 to enable the browser in one step.
_transports: stdio = local child process. http = Streamable HTTP (MCP 2025-03-26+), the transport current remote servers use. sse = the ORIGINAL HTTP+SSE transport, deprecated since 2025-03-26 — only for servers that still speak nothing else. The protocol version is negotiated automatically (server/discover, else an initialize handshake); set "protocolVersion" on an entry only to pin it.

servers._comment: Example remote server over Streamable HTTP. Headers are sent verbatim — put the token in the config file, not in the URL.
servers.name: example-remote
